objective: Keep Studio Projects progress display honest and tied to actual work evidence.
operator_observation: Projects page showed full-looking progress bars and bare '%' labels for items that were not implemented or done.
root_cause: The shared HTML escaping helper converted numeric zero to an empty string, causing progress_percent 0 to render as an invalid width:% style and a missing percentage label.
fix: Preserve numeric 0 in the HTML escaping helper while still rendering None as blank.
Add progress_basis labels so the Done column distinguishes not started, planned, estimate, evidence, and unverified progress.
Mark the Studio Projects Table Organization project as not_started instead of queued work with a misleading blank progress display.
training_lesson: MIM and TOD must not display progress as completion unless there is validation evidence. If progress is a plan, estimate, or backlog placeholder, the UI must say so directly.
